manifesto.title: THE TRENCHES
paragraphs: Loop Gaiden is a story about what memecoin culture became — farmers, extractors, manipulators, bundles, bots, snipers, insiders, devs, traders, communities, and everyone caught in between.
Through Loop, the comic explores the chaos, greed, humor, hope, wins, losses and absurdity of life in the trenches.
The Seven Greed Lords are part of the story.
statements: THE TRENCHES DECIDE WHAT HAPPENS NEXT. ∞

mission.title: STORIES FROM THE TRENCHES
mission.body: Loop Gaiden is an expanding comic universe inspired by the culture, characters, chaos and conflicts of the memecoin trenches.

chapters.title: LOOP GAIDEN
chapters.body: The trenches are the world. Loop is the protagonist. The comic can explore many stories from the culture around launches, hype, conviction, chaos and survival.

chapters.title: THE GREED LORDS
chapters.body: Seven manifestations of the greed that took over the trenches.
chapters.callout: The Greed Lords are only one chapter of the trenches.

chapters.title: BEYOND THE GREED LORDS
chapters.body: Future Loop Gaiden stories can move through rugs, CTOs, insiders, whales, KOLs, bots, devs, communities, launches, bull markets, bear markets, fake hype and real conviction.
